verdict: Useful draft generator; SEO/content-quality safeguards incomplete. Not a reliable publish-ready gate.

findings.issue: Research retains every model-written fact after filtering source URLs. There is no fact-to-source mapping or fetched supporting excerpt; checked date only records run date.
findings.recommendation: Require per-claim approved source URLs, jurisdiction, applicability/exemptions and retrieved evidence; reject unsupported facts.

findings.issue: Missing unsupported field defaults to an empty list. Valid JSON with the wrong shape is interpreted as a successful check.
findings.recommendation: Validate checker response schema; malformed verification must fail closed.

findings.issue: Unsupported claims only produce sidecar notes; removal of draft:true can publish them. Research is optional for legal/tax topics.
findings.recommendation: Require research and explicit review for sensitive topics; enforce unresolved-review status in the publishing/build workflow. Never invent reviewer identities.

findings.issue: Draft is written before image generation; image process failure exits before verification notes are saved. A partial draft can be left without its review warnings and can break draft preview builds.
findings.recommendation: Persist review record before image calls; stage and validate assets and Markdown before promoting draft.

findings.issue: Whitespace-only description, summary and image fields pass required-field checks because validation occurs before normalization. Reproduced with the actual audit function.
findings.recommendation: Validate normalized nonempty strings and structured arrays before accepting output.

findings.issue: Fixed default 1200-word minimum, 3–6 sections and paragraph word windows are treated as SEO pass/fail requirements. They can force padding in short announcements.
findings.recommendation: Use intent-appropriate editorial guidance; keep hard checks for genuine rendering and data-integrity requirements.

findings.issue: Normalized internal targets are validated but original noncanonical URLs are emitted; /about passes and is retained instead of /about/. Link targets also include utility noindex pages.
findings.recommendation: Emit validated canonical paths while preserving valid anchors; avoid irrelevant utility pages as suggested editorial links.

findings.issue: Slug uniqueness prevents overwrites but explicit topics are not checked for duplicate titles or substantive overlap; repeats become -2 URLs.
findings.recommendation: Compare new topics and titles against existing drafts/published posts and route revisions to existing articles when appropriate.

strengths: Known site categories and live-post link targets
Separate metadata fields and image alt prompts
Staging build validation with temporary BUILD_OUT
Site renderer supplies canonical, BlogPosting, breadcrumbs and sitemap integration
verification: Four mocked function probes passed: source fact leakage, missing checker field accepted, blank metadata accepted, noncanonical URL retained
limitations: No paid generation or image APIs called
No new posts generated or published
No arbitrary SEO or E-E-A-T score assigned
